_comment: Version -> cut commit: the durable half of issue #274. A CHANGELOG heading with no immutable ref is a claim without a SHA, and annotated tags live in the repository's ref namespace rather than in any branch — a clone that never fetched them cannot check the claim, and a tag created in a throwaway checkout is simply lost. This file is committed, so both problems go away: tests/test_docs_navigation.py binds every dated CHANGELOG heading to an entry here whose commit exists. Recreate and publish the tags with: jq -r '.releases[] | "git tag -a \(.tag) \(.commit) -m \"orca-fleet \(.version)\""' docs/releases.json | sh && git push origin --tags
